ln:4457086332.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our

customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Qualifications - Internal

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4454974805.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  • Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4443490068.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Why join us?

There is a digital revolution happening that is changing the future of banking - increasingly, Banking is Technology. Financial Services firms are becoming ever more defined by their technology and ability to use it to deliver outstanding customer experiences.

As a leading digital banking platform, we provide banking services, power global trade, commerce and financial services to our network and companies across 60 of the fastest growing markets in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. We’re digitising our banking services, adopting a cloud-first principle for all new software developments and major enhancements, making it easier for our clients to bank with us.

Markets Technology is at the heart of shaping the bank for the future and serving our clients digitally across the globe. Within Markets Technology, the SABRE team responsible for the development of Standard Chartered Analytics Booking and Risk Engine, CCIB's strategic cross asset pricing and risk management platform, built on top of the Bank’s in-house analytics library

What’s in it for you?

You will join as FM Market Risk and Pricing Expert within the Markets Technology SABRE in Guangzhou, China. You will manage and support global projects and users, working closely with Traders, Risk Managers and Product Controllers in Financial Markets, as well as the global SABRE team across China, Singapore, and London. This Change-The -Bank role requires leadership, creative thinking, problem solving skills and an ability to embrace and drive change.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • FM users: Front Office, Market Risk, Finance, Middle Office, Operations
  • Technology: Development leads, developers, testers, project managers, program manager, support groups

Skills And Experience

  • Academics: Mathematics / financial mathematics / statistics.
  • Knowledge of options & derivatives pricing in at least one asset class. Hands-on, able to reproduce and explain valuations
  • Understands Financial Markets organisation, experienced working with traders and Risk Managers
  • Scripting, SQL

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

About

We are looking for talented individuals who are passionate about Financial Markets, Technology and customer experience, and we value specialized expertise. If you possess traits and experience that match most of the below, we’d love to hear from you:

  • Minimum 8-year experience in Financial Markets, either within a financial institution or a risk management software company, in end user facing role(s). Solid understanding of Trading and Risk management software and practices.
  • Strong academic foundation in mathematics / financial mathematics, statistics. MSc or PhD preferred. Knowledge of options & derivatives pricing is at least one asset class is a must
  • Knowledge of options & derivatives risk and pricing in at least one asset class is a must.
  • Adaptive to changing situations and enjoy collaborating with global teams in a diverse multi-cultural environment.
  • Passionate for solving challenging problems, hands-on, customer service-oriented mindset.
  • Fluent English is a must.
  • Strong academic foundation in mathematics / financial mathematics, statistics. MSc or PhD preferred. Knowledge of options & derivatives pricing is at least one asset class is a must

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

ln:4448287575.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Financial Markets Technology function is responsible for the systems development and technology infrastructure which underpin the Bank’s services for Financial Markets clients.

Within The FM Technology Function, The FMRP Programme Aims At Transitioning The FM Trading Desks And Support Functions Away From The Existing Legacy Transaction Processing Systems And Into The Strategic Front To Back FM Technology Stack. The FM Re-platforming Programme Has Started Building The Strategic Technical Components For The Transaction Processing Functions

  • User Interface for pricing, booking and post-trade events capture,
  • External Trading Venues,
  • Trade booking API and automated life-cycling engine,
  • Trade Data Store and real-time event bus,
  • Credit Risk, Market Risk and Valuations platforms,
  • Integration/Coordination layer between components and all Operations systems,
  • Confirmations Engine,
  • Settlements Engine,
  • Finance Platform,
  • Unified data query API,
  • Self-service user reporting portal,

Lead Business Analyst is a hybrid role of both project management, business analysis and testing. You will assist with the execution of the roadmap along the vertical axis of the matrix organization. Your focus will be on overseeing delivery across the F2B Financial Market technology stack. This means you will be facilitating the delivery of features which cut across multiple systems (horizontals) and projects (verticals).

Your key responsibility will be working together with system owners, product owners and squad members of the horizontal functions to deliver fully integrated features across systems and the business analysts assigned to features across the verticals.

This will require a combination of strong project management, business analysis, testing, solution design and problem-solving skills. It’s a role which requires a profile comfortable working with a team of subject matters experts, business analysts, software engineers and testers, and engaging in the design details.

It’s an exciting and challenging role, which will expose you to full end-to-end processes across a financial markets and finance functions.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Execute and deliver the New Ventures roadmap.
  • Understand user requirements and study the feasibility.
  • Propose solutions that align to the strategic roadmap.
  • Translate solutions into detailed, unambiguous, business, and functional requirements.
  • Ensure the overall quality of business requirements, functional specifications and other supporting documents meet the bank’s standards.

Business

  • Working across asset classes FX, Rates, Credit and Commodities (both structured and flow).
  • Building strong, effective relationships with both the business and technology teams, across global offices.
  • Collaborating with all FO and control functions to gather requirements, solve business problems by proposing relevant, innovative solutions in consultation with the technology teams.
  • Work as part of an agile team including Business Analysts, Developers and Testers.
  • Be a creative source of proposals and channelling user aspiration towards sustainable and future proof solutions.

Processes

  • Provide support to the on-going build as required e.g., drafting/reviewing of test cases, closing out developers open issues/questions, contributing to solution design etc
  • Attend sprint planning meetings for your squad and work proactively with development and test leads.
  • Ensure documents such as functional specs support the development of practical technology solutions and suitable test cases.
  • Assist the business with UAT, including communication, planning, execution, preparation, and test case preparation

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Risk Management

  • Work closely with delivery leads to ensure stakeholders are fully engaged and expectations managed.
  • Identify risks and issues early, plan mitigating steps and communicate these to programme managers and business stakeholders in a timely manner
  • Cleary document and agree on assumptions, shortfalls and timelines to resolve the known constraints and dependencies.

Governance

  • Attending all relevant governance forums:
  • Daily Stand-Ups for your Squad
  • Sprint Planning and Retrospective for your Squad
  • Technical Design Authority Meetings

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

Key stakeholders

  • Business Stakeholders (Pre-Trade Product owners, Post-Trade Product Owners)
  • Technical Stakeholders (System Owner Delivery Leads, Business Initiative Delivery Leads)

Other Responsibilities

  • Do the right thing: Be brave, be the change; Think client; Live with integrity
  • Never Settle: Continuously improve and innovate; Simplify; Learn from your successes and failures
  • Better together: See more in others; How can I help? Build for the long term

Skills And Experience

  • Project Management
  • Business Analysis
  • Trade Processing
  • Trade Lifecycle
  • Financial Product Knowledge
  • Agile Methodology
  • Logical Data Modelling
  • FPML

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in full project delivery life cycle, in a front office business analyst capacity
  • Solid product knowledge across asset classes encompassing product & trade life cycle (Murex experience is a big plus)
  • Excellent understanding of the FO to BO trade flow of financial products, including Middle Office, Operations and Finance activities.
  • Ability to accurately translate and document business needs into functional requirements and produce high quality documentation (knowledge of UML, BPML notations are a plus)
  • Good understanding of key technology concepts, basics in logical/physical data models, programming and architecture. (Strong technical acumen is a plus)
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with excellent written and spoken English
  • Ability to work proactively, independently and displays strong initiative
  • Pragmatic team player with good attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Business, or related field of study

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4387284963.descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team:

Investment Bank: Fixed Income & Currencies

Fixed Income & Currencies brings together a top-ranked institutional sales force, world-class research with trading and structuring expertise across Foreign Exchange, Rates, Credit and Emerging Markets. The Fixed Income & Currencies business enables Deutsche Bank to respond to increasing automation, regulatory expectations and client demand for standardisation and transparency in execution across fixed income, currency and emerging markets.

Investment Bank: Investment Banking & Capital Markets

Investment Banking & Capital Markets aims to build long-term, trusted and mutually beneficial relationships with the major corporates, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereigns around the world. Our businesses cover Investment Banking Coverage, Debt Capital Markets (DCM), Equity Capital Markets (ECM), Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) etc.

Your Key Responsibilities And Required Skills

  • Looking for candidates with strong interest in Investment Bank – Fixed Income & Currencies (FIC) or Investment Banking & Capital Markets (IBCM). Ideal candidate should be a fast learner, attending to details, good with numbers.
  • Require candidates to be able to communicate well with the team, able to commit to work in terms of full attendance as agreed, and able to stay focused
  • Our interns are given the opportunity to learn about our business from different viewpoints, giving you a career advantage.


FIC:

  • Offer great exposure to how sales and trading work during market movements, with open environment that encourages discussions
  • Daily tasks involve data collection/maintenance of trading activities, market movements, DB’s pitch books/marketing materials
  • Assist team members in ad-hoc projects, fact finding, market research, documentation, KYC related task etc.
  • Administrative work including record keeping, data mining/analysis, liaise with back office when needed


IBCM:

  • Working on our day-to-day business as well as on special projects, you will contribute to the innovation of new ideas to help our customers achieve their financial goals
  • You will gain experience in different areas of our business and discover our market-leading solutions firsthand
  • Tasks may include credit research, preparing industry and market analyses for pitches, or getting involved in the execution of live deals


We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

ln:4465454802.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • As a Data Engineer your responsibilities include designing, building, and maintaining scalable data infrastructure and pipelines that enable data-driven decision making across the organization. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, business stakeholders, and development teams to ensure reliable, efficient, and secure data flow from various sources to analytics and reporting platforms.
  • Ultimately, you will be hands on working directly with cross-functional teams to architect and implement robust data solutions that support business intelligence, machine learning models, and operational reporting needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Pipeline Development and Maintenance - Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data from multiple sources into data warehouses and data lakes.
  • Data Architecture and Infrastructure - Design and implement data architecture solutions including data warehouses, data lakes, and streaming platforms using modern cloud technologies and best practices.
  • Data Quality and Governance - Implement data quality checks, validation frameworks, and monitoring systems to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and reliability across all data pipelines.
  • Performance Optimization - Optimize data pipelines and queries for performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency, ensuring data is available when needed with minimal latency.
  • Data Integration - Integrate data from diverse sources including databases, APIs, third-party services, and real-time streaming platforms to create unified data repositories.
  • Automation and Orchestration - Develop automated workflows using orchestration tools to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipeline execution and dependencies.
  • Collaboration with Data Teams - Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business intelligence teams to understand data requirements and deliver data solutions that enable insights and analytics.
  • Data Security and Compliance - Implement security best practices, access controls, and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) across all data systems.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing - Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data pipelines, architectures, and processes to enable team collaboration and knowledge transfer.
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting - Monitor data pipeline health, investigate data discrepancies, and troubleshoot issues to maintain high availability and reliability of data systems.
  • Innovation and Technology Evaluation - Stay current with emerging data technologies, tools, and best practices, evaluating and recommending new solutions to improve data infrastructure.

Strategy

  • Supports Hive Tech Lead, Product Area Lead and Engineering in strategy of data infrastructure and roadmap execution.
  • Deliver data solutions that make a significant contribution to the organization's strategic goals and enable data-driven decision making.
  • Contribute to data platform strategy and modernization initiatives across the organization.

Business

  • Promote engineering craftsmanship and focus on delivering business value through reliable and efficient data solutions.
  • Responsible for technical delivery and technical excellence of data pipelines and infrastructure across squads.
  • Works across multiple squads or hives for delivery of complex data integration projects, Features, Epics & Releases.
  • Point of escalation for data pipeline issues and delivery challenges across all impacted hives and squads.
  • Work with Change Delivery Manager (Release Manager) to develop delivery and release plans for data projects with technical dependencies, aligning all partners with support from the team and architect.
  • Exhibit passion for data quality and reliability with a user-first mindset for data consumers.
  • Drive the domain towards future state of banking and technology through modern data practices.
  • Ensure the technical consistency of data solutions with the business architecture, technology architecture and enterprise technology standards.

Processes

  • Study existing data engineering processes and contribute to improvements to drive up efficiencies in data delivery and operations.
  • Analyse, remove, or mitigate data dependencies across teams to enable speed and quality of delivery.
  • Responsible for the preparation of production data outputs and their planning in alignment to ESDLC standards.
  • Implement DataOps practices to streamline data pipeline development, testing, and deployment.

People & Talent

  • Work on upskilling technical expertise of Engineers to enable them to become more efficient in data engineering practices and tools.
  • Mentoring and training the squad on data engineering best practices, technologies, and methodologies.
  • Share knowledge on data modelling, pipeline design patterns, and performance optimization techniques.

Risk Management

  • Follows the standards with respect to risk management as applicable to their chapter domain.
  • Adheres to common practices to mitigate risk in their respective domain.

Governance

  • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies (e.g., SCB Governance Standards, ESDLC etc.).

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Architect, Engineering Leads.
  • Global Wealth Management Digital Owners, for business priority and initiatives.
  • Business & Technology Managers, for solution design and delivery.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Wealth Journey squad;
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

Skills And Experience

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Strong understanding of Wealth Journey and WM Sales Governance processes (onboarding New to Wealth customers, risk profiling, pre/post trade compliance check, portfolio performance and etc)
  • Software Product Technical Knowledge
  • Strong understanding of Wealth Journey Platform architecture, functionality, and capabilities, with hands-on experience in solution design, configuration, customisation, and integration.
  • Databases – Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, Vector DB
  • Container Platform – OCP, AKS, EKS
  • Agile Methodologies
  • Software Change Request Management
  • Application Delivery Process
  • Technical Troubleshooting

Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)

  • Previous experience in the Financial Technology (Wealth Management, Asset Management) sector.
  • Familiarity with financial concepts like portfolio modelling, rebalancing, risk profiling, and compliance regulations (e.g., FINRA, SEC).
  • Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack), and/or monitoring patterns for Databricks workloads, AI agents, LLM calls, and tool execution telemetry.
  • Experience building domain-oriented AI or analytics solutions for Wealth Advisory, client servicing, investment research, or advisor enablement use cases.
  • Familiarity with Databricks ML/AI capabilities, vector search, model serving, and integration patterns for enterprise LLM platforms.

Qualifications

  • Overall 10+ years of engineering experience building data-driven applications, with demonstrated delivery of enterprise-scale data platforms in cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-enabled capabilities, including retrieval-oriented data preparation, tool or service integration, and production observability for AI-driven workflows.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, and SQL, including hands-on PySpark development and practical data engineering patterns for AI and analytics workloads.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, Apache Spark, Kafka, Delta Lake, and scalable data design for batch and near real-time use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and relevant data services, with strong preference for Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with orchestration tools (such as Airflow) for pipeline scheduling, dependency management, and operational reliability across environments.
  • Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, data lakes, and data warehousing, with familiarity in vector data and retrieval patterns used by AI-enabled applications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data pipeline issues and distributed Spark workloads.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, analysts, business stakeholders, AI engineers, platform teams, and architects.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Job ID：63370

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions for private banking CRM, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT, vendors, and cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, resolve delivery and production issues, and design technical solutions.
  • Oversee end-to-end CRM implementations, including integration with legacy and peripheral systems, data migration, and GDPR compliance.
  • Mentor and develop technical teams, establish coding standards, and drive skill development programs.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, custom connectors, and automation solutions to accelerate project delivery and ensure high-quality outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership in ALM, DevOps, and system integration, ensuring robust governance and best practices across environments.
  • Support pre-sales activities, including solution design, PoC development, and technical presentations for private banking clients.
  • Ensure cost-effective, high-quality product solutions throughout the agile development lifecycle, including backlog management, estimation, and defect resolution.
  • Provide application incident support during off-business hours and as required by project delivery.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, with at least 4 years in Power Platform architecture and implementation.
  • Proven track record in delivering large-scale private banking CRM projects, including system integration, data migration, and regulatory compliance.
  • Advanced skills in Power Apps, Dataverse, plugin development, Azure administration, and ETL processes.
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, DevOps, and reusable solution frameworks.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading teams of 30+ members.
  • Microsoft Certifications:MB-210: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales Functional Consultant; PL-600: Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect
  • Experience in private banking or financial services CRM is essential.
  • Proficiency in Power Platform environments, solutions, and governance.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., ReactJS, AngularJS, Vue.js) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including code optimization, scalability, and performance.

/WX/LP

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4489567528.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
  • Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
  • Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
  • Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
  • Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
  • Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
  • Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
  • Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

Job Summary
This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.
The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.
Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.
Key Responsibilities
Service Delivery & Transaction Processing
- Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
- Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
- Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
- Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.
Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity
- Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
- Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
- Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
- Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.
Risk Management & Control Effectiveness
- Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
- Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
- Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
- Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.
Regulatory Compliance & Governance
- Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
- Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
- Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
- Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.
Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
- Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
- Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
- Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
- Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.
Stakeholder & Client Service Management
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
- Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
- Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
- Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.
Motivations
- Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
- Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
- Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.
Skills And Experience
Priority Skills
- Payment Processing
- Cash Management
- Certification and Accreditation
- Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
- Operations Management
- Project Management
- Service Delivery
- Settlement Management
Other Skills
- Transaction Management
- Issue Management
- Stakeholder Engagement
- Service Recovery
Qualifications
- Business English
